name: promo-video
description: Polished product promo / ad videos for desktop, web and mobile apps: scripted real-app capture, reel composition (TypeScript scenes on the GPU) with directed camera and text, beat-synced royalty-free music, narrated feature tutorials, a critic agent that reviews the storyboard and the render, capture adapters for Qt, the web and Godot games, and re-shooting a finished promo when the app changes. Also narrated devlogs / vlogs (narrator-vlog): before/after footage from the real app, a free offline narrator voice (Kokoro), burned-in subtitles, a pointer on the differences, reviewed by the vlog-critic agent.
